about: Data-only bounds on an inelastic channel that grows at least like T, from measured non-metal interface conductances (data/read-nonmetal.json). Worked out by hand first; test_tbc_nonmetal.py recomputes every number with tbc_nonmetal 0.1.0. Exploratory, not pre-registered (PLAN-amendment-0.5.md section 2). MW m^-2 K^-1.
